priorityList: Apply Instant Poison and enter Stealth before combat.
Keep Blade Flurry active at all times when fighting two or more targets.
Use Roll the Bones if you have no buffs active or if you only have a single buff.
Use Keep It Rolling if you have 2 or more Roll the Bones buffs active to extend them.
Cast Adrenaline Rush on cooldown, and use Preparation if Adrenaline Rush has more than 30 seconds remaining on cooldown.
Spend Combo Points when you are at maximum or one below maximum (typically 6 or more CP).
Prioritize Dispatch as a finisher if Slice and Dice is not active.
Use Between the Eyes as your highest priority finisher whenever it is off cooldown.
Use Coup de Grace as a finisher whenever it is available.
Use Killing Spree as a finisher on cooldown.
Use Dispatch as your filler finisher when other finishers are unavailable.
Use Coup de Grace during your builder phase if the Disorienting Strikes buff is active.
Use Ambush if you have an Audacity proc or Hidden Opportunity is active.
Use Pistol Shot when you have an Opportunity proc, especially at max stacks or if you need Combo Points.
Use Blade Rush and Vanish on cooldown to maximize damage and trigger Hidden Opportunity procs.
